company.shortDescription: Masmoo3 is specialized digital audio books production and publishing house in the arab world.
company.description: Masmoo3 is the first specialized production and publishing house for digital audio books in the Arab world. Masmoo3 aims to offer Arabic speakers an easy to access digital audio library composed of Arabic books. This will allow it to expand the availability of knowledge and make audio books an interesting experience for an Arabic-speaking audience. Aiming to produce more than 2000 original and translated Arabic audio books, Masmoo3’s team visualizes success by becoming a source of knowledge for Arabic speakers with high value content and high quality production.
